posts.name: Prakhar Arora
posts.cooked:
Dear student,

The most common problem student face here, is that the sed command is used as sed -n meaning no implicit printing. Try printing the pattern space yourself, most probably this is what is causing the issue.

REMARK: IN EXAMINATION PAY ATTENTION TO ALL THE SMALL DETAILS:

  1. HOW THE SCRIPT IS GOING TO RUN?
  2. WHERE IS THE INPUT COMING FROM, stdin or input file in pwd or cmd line arguments?
  3. WHERE TO SHOW OUTPUT, stdout or print to a file?
  4. DOES ERROR NEED TO BE REDIRECTED SOMEWHERE?
    and many other subtle informations.

Even if your logic or script is right but you haven’t taken this into account, a few of your test cases will fail. So pay attention here.

All the best!

Thank you
Prakahr Arora
Teching Assistant for System Commands
